title: Lighter product title and refined price composition
summary: Give the title priority and reduce price clutter with smaller decimals and inline currency.

changes.detail: Set the title in 26px medium type (23px compact), use a 24px medium price with 16px muted decimal digits, and place currency inline on the same baseline. Preserve locale grouping, exact amount and accessible full-price label.
